description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Credit-scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotification" name="Scoring delay notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Credit-scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking credit-scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Banking">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesClerk" name="Sales clerk">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_CreditScoringRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestScoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BankingSystem" name="Banking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendScoringRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisplayDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchLevel2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DisplayResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ResultDisplayed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CreditScoringRequest" name="Clerk requests credit scoring"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestScoring" name="Request credit scoring through frontend"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchDelay" name="Receive delay notification">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchDelay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayDelay" name="Display check-again-later message"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchImmediateResult" name="Receive level 1 result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel2Result" name="Receive level 2 result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchLevel2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayResult" name="Display scoring result at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ResultDisplayed" name="Result displayed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_CreditScoringRequest" targetRef="Task_RequestScoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_RequestScoring" targetRef="Task_SendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_5" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_6" sourceRef="Event_CatchDelay" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_7" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelay" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_8" sourceRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_DisplayResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_9" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Task_DisplayResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Task_DisplayResult" targetRef="End_ResultDisplayed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Agency">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Agency" name="Agency">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ScoringRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Level1Scoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Level1Outcome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendLevel1Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Level1ResultSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InformDelay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Level2Scoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendLevel2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Level2ResultSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Level1Outcome" name="Level 1 outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel1Result" name="Send level 1 result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level1ResultSent" name="Level 1 result returned"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformDelay" name="Inform banking process of delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send level 2 result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultSent" name="Level 2 result returned"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="Start_ScoringRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_3" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendLevel1Result">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Level 1 result is determined immediately</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" name="Result takes longer" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Task_InformDelay">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Level 1 result cannot be determined immediately</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel1Result" targetRef="End_Level1ResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_8" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_Level2ResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Banking" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Start_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotification" name="Delay notification" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Event_CatchDelay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level1Result" name="Level 1 result" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel1Result" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result" name="Level 2 result" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
